title: Energy in a larger capacitor
hook: Change capacitance and predict stored electric energy.
misconception: stored electric energy stays fixed when capacitance doubles.
objective: Apply U = CV²/2 to compare stored electric energy when capacitance changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal capacitor at fixed voltage magnitude, U = CV²/2. When capacitance doubles, stored electric energy becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model U = CV²/2; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal capacitor at fixed voltage magnitude, with a nonzero initial result. If capacitance triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on stored electric energy?
recall.why: Apply U = CV²/2 under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
